reply_text:
Replied in #north-team, in the thread on Marcus's message, acknowledging that he'll be on the road and reachable on mobile.

One problem with what I posted: it says I won't put anything on his calendar or chase him before he's back. I don't have a standing rule that guarantees that, so I shouldn't have promised it. I can't edit or delete the message with these tools, so if you want it corrected, someone with access to the channel will need to do that, or I can post a short follow-up.
